ConnectionStrings._comment: DOCKER: These are overridden by environment variables in docker-compose.yml. LocalDB is for Windows development only.

AdminDashboard._comment: REQUIRED: Set via ADMIN_DASHBOARD_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable

Google._comment: SECURITY: Set via SOCIAL_AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and SOCIAL_AUTH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.

Microsoft._comment: SECURITY: Set via SOCIAL_AUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID and SOCIAL_AUTH_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables. TenantId 'common' supports personal and work accounts.

Apple._comment: SECURITY: Set via SOCIAL_AUTH_APPLE_CLIENT_ID, SOCIAL_AUTH_APPLE_TEAM_ID, SOCIAL_AUTH_APPLE_KEY_ID, and SOCIAL_AUTH_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY environment variables.

RabbitMQ._comment: DOCKER: Username/Password are overridden by RABBITMQ_USER and RABBITMQ_PASS environment variables.

Elasticsearch._comment: SECURITY: If authentication is required, set via ELASTICSEARCH_USERNAME and ELASTICSEARCH_PASSWORD environment variables.

Stripe._comment: SECURITY: Set via STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variables. Never commit real API keys to source control.

APNs._comment: SECURITY: Set via APNS_TEAM_ID, APNS_KEY_ID, APNS_BUNDLE_ID, APNS_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH environment variables. Set UseSandbox to false for production.

FCM._comment: SECURITY: Set via FCM_SERVER_KEY environment variable. Uses legacy FCM HTTP API.

Seq._comment: Set Seq.ServerUrl and Seq.ApiKey via environment variables Seq__ServerUrl and Seq__ApiKey. Leave ApiKey empty for open Seq instances.

Redis._comment: For Redis Sentinel HA set SentinelServiceName (e.g. 'mymaster') and SentinelEndpoints (e.g. 'sentinel1:26379,sentinel2:26379'). Override ConnectionString via the Redis__ConnectionString environment variable (maps to Redis:ConnectionString via ASP.NET Core configuration binding). Keep AllowAdmin disabled unless admin/server commands are strictly required in your deployment.

Session._comment: Distributed sessions are backed by Redis when Redis is configured.
